versions.title: Firmware v2 initial release
versions.summary: Firmware v2 debuts with improved CAN communication cadence and performance.

items.text: Improved CAN communication cadence and performance

versions.title: CAN bus cadence and performance improvements
versions.summary: Improved CAN communication cadence and overall performance. (Shipped alongside v2.0.)

items.text: Improved CAN communication cadence and performance

versions.title: Grasp / blend / input validation stability
versions.summary: Fixed numerous stability issues around in-grasp position control, torque limits, blend saves, and IP/Port validation.

items.text: Fixed position control not working on position-locked joints during grasp
Clears prior values when saving the blend list
Fixed twitch on grasp release
Prevent 0 from being entered for the first IP byte and Port
Torque-limit off: target current can now be entered up to 1.3A (1300)
Display current blend index during blend playback (inputRegister 4)

versions.title: Short Wrist model and 6-axis F/T sensor
versions.summary: Added Short Wrist model and 6-axis F/T sensor option.

items.text: Added Short Wrist model
Added 6-axis F/T sensor option
Added OFFSET command for the 6-axis F/T sensor

versions.title: Developer mode and EEPROM stability
versions.summary: Blocked Ethernet port 2607 and fixed developer-mode sensor data, EEPROM write, and GPIO display bugs.

items.text: Blocked Ethernet port 2607 (avoids collision with bootloader-reserved port)
Added command to capture sensor offsets in developer mode
Sensor data changed from 1 byte to 2 bytes in developer mode
Fixed ID being sent alongside sensor-only data in developer mode
Fixed EEPROM write bug
Fixed mismatch between GPIO voltage level and displayed value
Improved RS485 communication

versions.title: Grasp / offset stabilization
versions.summary: Fixed grasp-release and offset bugs and added real-time motor error detection.

items.text: Added real-time motor error detection
Fixed grasp release bug
Fixed offset bug

versions.title: Load registers extended
versions.summary: Start-pose and gain index now also apply to load registers.

items.text: Start pose and gain value index now apply to load registers

versions.title: Developer mode stability
versions.summary: Fixed duty sign, offset application, and simultaneous-mode activation bugs in developer mode.

items.text: Fixed duty sign vs. motor direction mismatch in developer mode
Fixed offset being applied in developer mode
Prevented current control and teaching mode from being active simultaneously

versions.title: 1F/2F models and homing
versions.summary: Added 1F and 2F model support and a homing (origin capture) feature.

items.text: Added 1F, 2F models
Added homing (origin capture) feature
Motor error values now returned when a module disconnects

versions.title: ShortWrist and motor error-detection stability
versions.summary: Fixed a ShortWrist switch-order issue and several grasp-mode bugs.

items.text: Fixed incorrect ShortWrist switch order
Fixed grasp and grasp-mode bugs
Fixed motor error-detection code bug

versions.title: DG-S models and tactile sensor support
versions.summary: Added DG-S model and tactile sensor support. Error code scheme reorganized into the 400 series.

items.text: Added DG-S model
Added DG-S tactile sensor
Implemented step move during position control inside a grasp
Changed error codes to the 400 series
Sensor errors now start at 421 regardless of model
CURRENTHYSTERESIS set to 5
